mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing foggy conditions with a temperature of 70 degrees at the Verona Area High School, and we are currently under a New Moon phase.

Important city updates include new notices for the upcoming August partisan primary and the start of road construction on Highway M beginning August 18, which will include lane shifts and utility work for the next few weeks.
We have a busy schedule today with yoga at Insight Wellness, concerts in the park, and trivia at Hop Haus, followed by live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow.
In a report covering August 3 to August 10, police noted an incident on August 6 where an officer arrested a driver for an O W I, which was their fourth offence.
The flavor of the day is Devils Food Cake. Culver's is currently closed, but they open their doors at 10 AM today. If you miss out, tomorrow's flavor is Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough.
